popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book 20: son of Dardanus, richest of mortals, with three thousand mares in the marsh — father of Tros and link in the Trojan king-list. Not the Athenian Erichthonius born of Hephaestus.

popCulture.title: Erichthonius (son of Dardanus)
popCulture.description: King of Dardania between Dardanus and Tros — distinct from Erichthonius of Athens.
